limitations: For each fixed graph order at least four: adjacency evolution and missing-edge endpoint pair only; no graph-order uniform constants and no optimal leading infidelity constant. Qualitative PGST and non-PST on this same family are previously known.
scientific_integrity: Unrestricted result proved by two-frequency spectral reduction, quadratic-field norm, and bounded continued fractions. Finite standard-library calculations only supplement the proof; prior qualitative results are explicitly attributed.
title: Sharp quadratic waiting-time law for quantum transfer across a missing edge
